blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman-turned-witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday that a former member of the so-called “Maleta boys” told him he was paid to recant his testimony. Rodante Orbillo made the revelation when he took the witness stand before the anti-graft court to testify in the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez stemming from P7.44 billion worth of alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects delivered by the purported bagmen.
